rec.comment: hours = Rec opening hours (ET), Fall 2026 (Aug 21 - Dec 9) from miamioh.edu/athletics-recreation/recreation/about/hours.html. UPDATE EACH TERM: the baseline is measured during closed hours, and patrons read 0 outside these hours. baselineDevices = fallback baseline used only when no closed-hours readings exist (e.g. after an outage). capacity = real head-count capacity; widgetMax = MAX_CAPACITY hard-coded in the public Rec widget. /recapi scales data.patrons by widgetMax/capacity; they are equal until the Rec gives us a real capacity.

collection.comment: Silent window [start, end) in Eastern hours: DB writes are skipped while start <= hour < end. The Rec opens earlier than King, so it resumes collecting at 05:00.
